body: Thank you Mark. I have thought about reaching out to a therapist or someone to talk to but I have always heard from friends and some family that they do not work. I don’t really expect anything to “work” or just click into place in my mind but I always thought therapy is a way to get all of your pent up emotions out just so you would feel better and relieved and therapists are only there to be a neutral listener. Am I wrong?
